postCreateCommand.idealyst-claude-install: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash && { sudo -n ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/claude" /usr/local/bin/claude 2>/dev/null || ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/claude" /usr/local/bin/claude 2>/dev/null || true; }
postCreateCommand.idealyst-cli-install: chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /idealyst/cli 2>/dev/null || sudo -n chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /idealyst/cli; test -x /idealyst/cli/bin/idealyst || cargo install --git https://github.com/IdealystIO/idealyst-native idealyst-cli --root /idealyst/cli; sudo -n ln -sf /idealyst/cli/bin/idealyst /usr/local/bin/idealyst 2>/dev/null || ln -sf /idealyst/cli/bin/idealyst /usr/local/bin/idealyst 2>/dev/null || true
